caseNameFull: Chu Tai Ngan v. Samuel W. Backus, Commissioner, etc.
attorneys: Mr. O. P. Stidger and Mr. C. L. Bouve for the petitioner. No brief for the respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit dismissed on motion of counsel for the petitioner.
